title: WorldClaim v1
description: A GAIA governed world-state claim. A claim is not admissible without anchors, source evidence, temporal validity, uncertainty, and policy status. Formal invariant: Observation/Evidence -> ProposedWorldClaim -> ExplanationTrace + Uncertainty -> PolicyDecision -> Admitted/Provisional/Review WorldClaim. Additive CHRONOS-carrier-compatible v1: chronos_grounding_status and chronos_owning_authority_plane extend this contract to satisfy sociosphere's neurosymbolic-chronos-alignment.md carrier boundary (SocioProphet/gaia-world-model#38) without changing any existing field or behavior.

geo_anchor.description: Inline or referenced GeoAnchor binding this claim to a verifiable spatial-temporal location.

source_evidence_refs.description: References to SourceEvidence records supporting this claim. At least one is required.

proposed_value.description: The asserted world-state value (feature type, risk class, coverage fraction, etc.).

confidence_score.description: Combined confidence score for this claim.

policy_status.description: Governance status of this world claim. Admitted claims may appear on /map; provisional/review claims require explicit qualification.

status.description: proposed: evidence assembled, not yet reviewed. provisional: partially admitted with constraints. admitted: fully governed. review: flagged for human review. rejected: not admissible.

constraints.description: Active constraints on this claim (e.g. display-advisory-only, requires-human-review).

explanation_trace_ref.description: Reference to a FusionExplanation trace record for this claim.

map_display.description: How this claim should be displayed on /map. Admitted claims may be shown as truth layers; others must carry visible qualification. The 'default' values below are metadata hints for consuming applications; schema validators do not enforce defaults.

vector_candidate_ref.description: Optional reference to a VectorCandidate for similar-observation retrieval. VectorCandidate.status is always candidate_only and must not influence policy decisions.

standards_refs.description: References to SocioProphet standards documents governing this claim.

chronos_grounding_status.description: CHRONOS carrier grounding status (sociosphere/docs/integration/neurosymbolic-chronos-alignment.md 'neuro-symbolic carrier boundary'; SocioProphet/gaia-world-model#38). Whether proposed_value is grounded in verifiable source evidence with anti-leakage/transduction checks (per the alignment doc's SATNet/dILP guidance), partially grounded, ungrounded, unknown, or not_applicable (e.g. simple deterministic passthrough where grounding is not the relevant frame). Additive: does not replace or duplicate uncertainty.confidence_score/uncertainty_class, which remain GAIA's existing confidence measure.

chronos_owning_authority_plane.description: CHRONOS carrier owning authority plane (SocioProphet/gaia-world-model#38): names the repo/plane holding final admission authority for THIS claim's policy_status, e.g. 'SocioProphet/holmes'. Per docs/contracts/GOVERNED_WORLD_CLAIM_CONTRACT.md, GAIA owns Observe->Anchor->Normalize->Propose; this field records who owns the Verify->Govern decision this claim is awaiting or has received, per sociosphere's CHRONOS authority-boundary table. Additive: does not move canonical-schema authority for WorldClaim/SourceEvidence away from GAIA.
